items.title_en: Legendary Nigerian actor Olu Jacobs dies aged 84

items.desc_en: Olu Jacobs was one of Nigeria's most recognised actors, whose career spanned several decades.
items.desc_zh: 奥卢·雅各布斯是尼日利亚最受认可的演员之一，其职业生涯长达数十年。

items.desc_zh: 交易员预计 FOMC 将投票将隔夜基金利率提高四分之一个百分点的可能性超过 90%。

items.title_en: J.B. Hunt stock plunges 10% after company warns third-quarter earnings will fall
items.title_zh: J.B. Hunt 警告第三季度盈利将下降，股价暴跌 10%
items.desc_en: Shares of J.B. Hunt plunged more than 10% Wednesday after the company warned of an earnings drop between 5% and 10%.
items.desc_zh: J.B. Hunt 警告称盈利将下降 5% 至 10%，周三该公司股价暴跌 10% 以上。

items.title_en: Tropical Smoothie Cafe is getting a makeover as it prepares for its 'next 3,000' locations

items.title_en: Ed Yardeni slashes S&P 500 target, says ‘proceed with caution’ in stocks as rates rise

items.desc_en: The sharp rise in bond yields is making even the biggest market bulls nervous. Ed Yardeni is no exception.
items.desc_zh: 债券收益率的急剧上升甚至让市场上最大的多头感到紧张。艾德·亚德尼也不例外。

items.title_en: Advil-maker Haleon boosts sales by targeting consumers on weight-loss drugs
items.title_zh: Advil 制造商 Haleon 通过针对减肥药消费者来提高销量
items.desc_en: Advil maker Haleon is capitalizing on the GLP-1 boom, boosting sales of products that combat weight loss drugs side effects with strategic store placement.
items.desc_zh: Advil 制造商 Haleon 正在利用 GLP-1 的热潮，通过战略性的商店布局来提高对抗减肥药物副作用的产品的销量。

items.title_en: EU chief backs plan for Canada to become 'associate member'

items.desc_en: Canada is seeking closer ties with EU after a breakdown in relations with the US and its president Donald Trump.

items.title_en: World's top-performing sovereign wealth fund warns of looming pullback in U.S. stock market

items.desc_en: Rising oil prices and Treasury yields are lifting energy and borrowing costs for U.S. households, pushing consumers to draw more heavily on savings.
items.desc_zh: 不断上涨的油价和国债收益率正在推高美国家庭的能源和借贷成本，促使消费者更多地动用储蓄。

items.title_en: Philippines' Duterte seen in person at International Criminal Court for first time

items.desc_zh: 他将因反毒品战争造成数千人死亡而因反人类罪受到审判。

items.title_zh: 由于利率突然飙升，购房者的抵押贷款需求同比下降 19%

items.title_en: Colombia and Brazil deadliest countries for environmental activists, report says
items.title_zh: 报告称哥伦比亚和巴西是环保活动人士死亡人数最多的国家
items.desc_en: The two countries accounted for 52% of killings of environmental activists in 2025, according to Global Witness.
items.desc_zh: 据 Global Witness 称，到 2025 年，这两个国家造成的环保活动人士遇害人数中，有 52% 是由这两个国家造成的。

items.title_en: Living abroad doesn't end your U.S. tax obligations. What young expats need to know
items.title_zh: 居住在国外并不会终止您在美国的纳税义务。年轻的外籍人士需要知道什么
items.desc_en: Americans living overseas may still face U.S. tax-filing and foreign-account reporting rules — even when they ultimately owe no U.S. income tax.
items.desc_zh: 居住在海外的美国人可能仍面临美国纳税申报和外国账户报告规则——即使他们最终不欠美国所得税。

items.title_en: Canada invited to become EU’s first ‘associate member’ as Trump trade war intensifies
items.title_zh: 随着特朗普贸易战加剧，加拿大受邀成为欧盟首个“准成员”
items.desc_en: EU chief Ursula von der Leyen said the bloc wants to open the door for Canada to become its first associate member, signaling a major deepening of ties.
items.desc_zh: 欧盟主席乌苏拉·冯德莱恩表示，欧盟希望为加拿大成为其第一个准成员打开大门，这标志着双方关系的重大深化。

items.title_en: Flyers are happier with U.S. airports, despite near record travel levels, J.D. Power report shows

items.desc_zh: 研究显示，旅客给予较高评分的部分原因是许多机场近年来开设了较新的登机口和航站楼。
